title: Resources page
content:
Resources from the marker's desk

Everything in the shop is made by Lynsey — a teacher with over 20 years in Scottish classrooms who marks the real SQA exams. Live masterclasses, downloadable revision materials, and whatever she adds next: it all lands here first.

What you'll find there

The shop is where everything lives — new resources appear there the moment Lynsey adds them, so it's always worth a look.

Live Sunday masterclasses

Exam-focused sessions for National 5, Higher and Advanced Higher, September to April — each with the recording and resources included.

Downloadable materials

Notes, worksheets and practice materials, written the way the SQA wants answers written. Bought once, downloaded instantly, yours to keep.

Masterclass passes

The whole year of masterclasses secured in one go — with a free pack of revision flashcards posted to your door.

Buying takes about a minute

1 · Pay securely

Card or PayPal, handled by the shop — the same secure checkout every time.

2 · Delivered instantly

Downloads and joining details arrive by email the moment payment goes through.

3 · Keep it forever

Files are yours for good, and masterclass recordings follow after each session.

Chemistry Exam Edge

Eight Sunday masterclasses to build confidence, skills and exam marks — one hour per level, last Sunday of every month from September to April. Book single sessions from £18, or secure all eight with the Masterclass Pass.
